issue-4192: Export button stays greyed out after a failed export
Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

<!-- sentinel: SNTL-TEAL-GODWIT -->

Discuss

args.title: Re-enable Export button after failed export to allow retry
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `exportReport` function does not reset the `busy` state if the export fails (e.g., due to a server error). This causes the Export button to remain disabled until the page is reloaded. The fix is to wrap the `exportReport` call in a `try-catch` block and reset `busy` to `false` in the `catch` block, ensuring the button is re-enabled for retry.
